title: Agent Talk direct request body
description: The body of one POST to a service's https carrier: the signed step whole, without seq, and the door it is for on a first ask to an open door.
$comment: Checks only code can do: the body at most 64 KiB; the service token in the Authorization header; the step's sig verifying against a key of the token's iss; admission (protocol 9.3). The reference implementation's body reader checks only that step is an object, and refuses a bad step afterwards with the uniform refusal rather than a 400.

door.description: The door id from the door document of an address in the ask's to.
